title: Vanishing orders of Dirichlet solutions to the Schrödinger equation in dimensions three and higher
summary: Let $B_3=B(0,3)\subset\mathbb{R}^3$. For every sufficiently large integer $k$, we construct a nonzero real function $u_k\in C^2(\overline{B_3})$ and a real potential $V_k\in L^\infty(B_3)$ such that $Δu_k=V_ku_k$, $u_k|_{\partial B_3}=0$, $\mathrm{ord}_0u_k=k$, and $\|V_k\|_\infty\le Ck^{3/2}$. Consequently, for every sufficiently large $N$, there is such a Dirichlet solution with potential norm smaller than $N$ and vanishing order at least $cN^{2/3}$.
